Run the staged monorepo trading bot scan with ~/trading-bot/monorepo-staging/scripts/run_trading_bot_rehearsal.sh

After it completes, run ~/trading-bot/monorepo-staging/scripts/print_trading_bot_operator_summary.sh and send that summary to Telegram. Do not improvise from raw logs when the summary wrapper is available. If the summary says safe mode remained active, preserve that wording explicitly.
